correctness.rationale: The helper implements the inspectable contract from the diff: PR-number validation, allow-list loading with [bot] stripping, env defaults (INTERVAL=20, QUIET_WINDOW=360, MAX_WAIT=900), head SHA checks before/after each GraphQL snapshot (plus snap_head cross-check), machine-readable RESULT=/HEAD= emission with documented exit codes, and poll-loop branches for CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, QUIET_ELAPSED, TIMEOUT, SHA_CHANGED, and API_ERROR. Bats fixtures exercise the embedded snapshot_parser decision logic across converged, pending, quiet-elapsed, and unresolved-thread cases. Minor contract gaps: reviews and reviewThreads are capped at 100 nodes without pagination, and terminal-bot detection keys only on a review commit matching head SHA (any review state) without filtering outdated threads.

quality.rationale: Implementation is clear and repo-consistent (set -uo pipefail, trap cleanup, dedicated scripts/checks/160-pr-resolve-poll.sh, required-files and scripts lint inventory updates). The embedded snapshot_parser.py is deliberately extractable for tests, which is a maintainable pattern. Docs are synced in pr-resolve-all.md (helper preference, exit/result dispatch table, preserved time-based fallback) and AI_REPO_GUIDE.md. Deductions for style consistency: ~385 lines of inline GraphQL plus embedded Python in one shell file rather than extracted scripts/lib/jq filters used elsewhere, printf-only diagnostics instead of shared logging.sh, and no scripts/README.md or scripts/tests/README.md companion updates present in the diff.

process.rationale: Diff is tightly scoped to eight on-task files (helper, allow-list, bats tests, three check scripts, and required doc/prompt surfaces) with no AGENTS.md, PLAN.md, or live-state churn. pr-resolve-all.md prefers the deterministic helper while preserving the documented QUIET_WINDOW fallback. Companion maintenance covers required-files inventory, scripts lint inventory, and a dedicated invariant check wired through test.sh.

reliability.rationale: scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats meaningfully tests snapshot_parser decision logic (extracted from the helper via awk) and CLI precondition paths (--help, bad args, missing allow-list to exit 4 RESULT=API_ERROR). However the bats file explicitly defers the live polling loop and provides no mock-gh coverage for TIMEOUT, SHA_CHANGED, or end-to-end CONVERGED/QUIET_ELAPSED through the poll loop—unlike stronger peers that stub gh for all five result paths. Objective grading skipped bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh, so wiring is credible (test_wiring 2/2) but execution and poll-loop contract paths are not bundle-verified.

uncertainty_notes: bats_poll_helper was skipped in objective-grade.json; subjective reliability score treats parser/CLI tests as structurally sound but does not assume poll-loop scenarios passed at runtime.
Live GitHub polling behavior (gh auth, GraphQL fetch, SHA_CHANGED/TIMEOUT timing) is only evidenced by code inspection in diff.patch, not by executed integration tests in the bundle.

citations.claim: hard_gate_pass is true, enabling normal subjective scoring rather than fail-closed zeroing.
emit_result prints RESULT= with optional HEAD=, ELAPSED=, PARTICIPATING=, TERMINAL=, UNRESOLVED= and maps CONVERGED/QUIET_ELAPSED to exit 0, TIMEOUT to 2, SHA_CHANGED to 3, API_ERROR to 4.
Poll loop fetches head_before, GraphQL snapshot, snap_head, and head_after; emits SHA_CHANGED when head diverges from EXPECTED_HEAD.
snapshot_parser sets CONVERGED when unresolved==0 and all participating bots are terminal (review commit.oid == head_sha); QUIET_ELAPSED when latest actionable event is older than QUIET_WINDOW.
GraphQL query fetches reviews(last:100) and reviewThreads(first:100) without pagination beyond the first page.
Precondition failures (missing/unreadable allow-list, missing gh, auth failure, repo resolution failure) emit RESULT=API_ERROR with exit 4.
scripts/lib/bot-allowlist.txt lists seven normalized bot identities (gemini-code-assist through claude) with matching documentation.
pr-resolve-all.md adds settle-window section preferring scripts/pr-resolve-all-poll.sh with exit/result table and retains documented time-based QUIET_WINDOW fallback.
scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats states the live GitHub polling loop is intentionally not exercised and tests only extracted snapshot_parser logic plus CLI/precondition paths.
scripts/checks/160-pr-resolve-poll.sh verifies helper and allow-list exist, prompt references helper and fallback, and invokes run_bats_check for the bats file.
bash_n_poll_helper and lint_poll_helper passed; bats_poll_helper skipped; test_wiring matched 2/2 patterns (6/6 objective reliability wiring points).
Eight focused files spanning helper, allow-list, bats tests, checks, and doc/prompt surfaces with no unrelated scope.
